MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.

2. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.

3. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

4. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

5. When practising Reading for Understanding, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Understanding.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Understanding.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Understanding.

6. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Oral Expression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Phonological Awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

4. B — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

5. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Phonological Awareness; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

10. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Listening for Information; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
